en.plugins.fancy.desc: Generate fancy text in different styles
en.plugins.fancy.usage:
📝 *Fancy Text Styles*

📌 *Usage:* {0}fancy <style> <text>
*Example:* {0}fancy 5 Hello World

*Available styles:*
{1}

Use {0}fancy all <text> to see every style.
en.plugins.fancy.no_text:
❌ Please provide a text to convert.

Example: {0}fancy 5 Hello World
en.plugins.fancy.too_long: ❌ The text is too long (max {0} characters).
en.plugins.fancy.invalid_style: ❌ Invalid style. Use a number between 1 and {0}, or "all".
